description: Implements ADR-005 decision 1. The canonical server is currently hard single-tenant: getPaths() in storage.ts resolves one global ZUG_DATA_DIR (/data/.zug); handleSyncPull(since)/handleSyncPush(body) in sync-server.ts take no identity; createServer() in http.ts uses global paths. Two paying users would share one fingerprint. Work: (1) move content to /data/users/<userId>/.zug/…; (2) thread a userId dimension through getPaths() and every storage fn, server.ts gate handlers, sync-server.ts handlers, and synthesize.ts; (3) per-user synthesis queue so one user's session-end can't block another's (also the COGS/abuse throttle point). Content stays file-based per ADR-001 — the append-only-log + projection + merge.ts/synthesize.ts engines are unchanged, just run per user. This is the long pole and gates accounts, billing, tiering, migration, and GDPR. Acceptance: two distinct authenticated users get fully isolated PERSONA/PLAYBOOK/logs; existing single-user data migrates to a userId namespace without loss.
title: Multi-tenancy: namespace all storage by userId (foundation)
